hypothesis: A seven-day cash deadline prevents inventory from occupying the next weekly opportunity. Recent comparable weeks can determine whether to buy at the open, wait for a dip, or stay in cash.
asset: Native Toncoin on Bybit public spot GRAMUSDT. WhiteBIT GRAM_USDT checked independently on the available tail. External transfer test uses WhiteBIT XLM_USDT with no coin-specific tuning.
historical_design: Use all complete Monday 01 UTC to following Monday 01 UTC episodes with 28 days of closed-hour features. Test the two fixed chronological 52-week periods starting 2024-11-18 and 2025-11-17 separately. Retrospective research; the Toncoin returns of other policies in those years have already been seen.
actions: CASH, buy at first open, or place a buy limit 3% below the first open for 72 hours. Trade-through by the adverse-price allowance is required on limits. Model a worse entry if price touches stop on the entry bar. Profit limit +5%, stop -3% of effective entry price, adverse gaps use worse opening price. When ordering inside the bar, prohibit a favorable same-bar target and allow an adverse same-bar stop. For all actions close by next Monday 01 UTC. On any missing candle omit entire week, including from training.
costs: All virtual capital, no leverage. Standard fee 0.10% plus 0.05% adverse price per side, stressed fee 0.10% plus 0.15% adverse price per side. Use stressed outcomes for every model fit in both evaluations.
features: At the decision use daily closes through yesterday: 7-day return / 0.10, 27-day return / 0.20, position within 28-day closing range, and mean of last seven absolute daily changes / 0.03. Manhattan distance. No normalization from future data.
training: Use at most 104 calendar weeks of settled local observations. The previous episode's deadline must strictly precede the present choice; the just-ending week is embargoed. Minimum 24 matured. Take the 12 nearest by feature distance, prefer later week for ties. Remove the single best return per action, divide remaining sum by 13 to add two zero-return examples. Enter only if the higher robust estimated weekly account return exceeds 0.5%. Ties prefer waiting for a dip. Observations are non-overlapping counterfactual weeks per action. Store both policy outcomes, chosen action, feature vector and training identifiers.
qualification: Require each complete 52-week later partition independently to achieve >=2% net geometric and median weekly return, beat cash and both fixed policies under stressed costs, and have <=25% maximum hourly marked drawdown. Missing weeks invalidate qualification. No automatic activation of a new trader. Track the currently running Toncoin positions separately.
